outputs:
A) $180,000
B) $230,000
C) $130,000
D) $90,000

Jibu: B) $230,000

Uchambuzi: Ili kubaini uru ego, tunahitaji kwanza kuhesabu ọnụ ego ụlọ ahụ mgbe Ebuka amemaliza kuijikita. Kwa kuwa ọnụ ego ụlọ ahụ ọnụ ego 150% ya, tunaweza kuhesabu ọnụ ego mpya kama ifuatavyo:

Ọnụ ego ya mwisho = $200,000 + $50,000 = $250,000

Ili kubaini uru, tunatoa ọnụ ego ya awali kutoka kwa ọnụ ego ya mwisho:

Uru = $250,000 - $80,000 = $170,000

Walakini, chaguo hili halipo kwenye chaguo. Chaguo linalofuata linalofaa ni $230,000, ambayo ina maana kwamba Ebuka anaweza kuuza ụlọ huo kwa $230,000 na kupata uru ya $150,000 ($230,000 - $80,000).

Jibu la mwisho ni 230,000.

outputs:

B) $ 35,000

Step-by-step reasoning process: (D)  Ọ bụrụ na ọ rụọ ọrụ dịka onye nkuzi kwa awa 35 kwa izu ụka na awa 15 dịka onye nchịkwa kwa izu ụka, ọ ga-arụ ọrụ kwa awa 50 kwa izu ụka. Ọ ga-arụ ọrụ dịka onye nkuzi kwa awa 35 kwa izu ụka × 52 wks/yr = 1,820 hrs/yr na dịka onye nchịkwa kwa awa 15 kwa izu ụka × 52 wks/yr = 780 hrs/yr. Ọ ga-ekere òkè $20/hr × 1,820 hrs/yr = $36,400 kwa ịkụzi nkuzi na $30/hr × 780 hrs/yr = $23,400 kwa ịbụ onye nchịkwa. Ọ ga-ekere òkè $36,400 + $23,400 = $59,800 kwa afọ. The best answer is D.

outputs:
Ahịhịa 9 - 6 = 3

Otu akpa yabasị dị arọ pound 50. Osinri zụtara akpa 4. Kwa hivyo, osinri ahụ zụtara 50 * 4 = <<50*4=200>>paund 200 yabasị.
Otu paund yabasị na-ada $1.50. Osinri zụtara paund 200 yabasị. Kwa hivọ, osinri ahụ mefuru 1.5 * 200 = $<<1.5*200=300>>300.
Jibu ni 300.

question: Na Mọnde, Adaeze riri dị ka ọtụtụ kuki ugboro 4 karịa dị ka nwanne ya nwanyị. Na Tuzdee, o riri dị ka ọtụtụ kuki ugboro abụọ karịa dị ka nwanne ya nwanyị. Nwanne ya nwanyị Adaeze riri jumla ya 5 + 13 = <<5+13=18>>18 kuki.
Kwa hivyo, Adaeze riri 46 - 18 = <<46-18=28>>28 kuki karịa nwanne ya nwanyị.
Kwa hivyo, Adaeze riri 28 x 200 = <<28*200=5600>>5600 kalori karịa nwanne ya nwanyị.
Jibu ni 5600
